description:
Cursor-paginated list of Midnight markets.

**Use this to discover markets.** For a given user's positions on those markets, follow up with `morpho_midnight_list_user_positions`.

**Filters.** Address filters (`loan_assets`, `collateral_assets`, `oracle_addresses`, `enter_gates`, `liquidator_gates`) must be combined with `chain_ids` — an address alone is not chain-unique. Lowercase addresses are checksummed server-side. Pass `active_only=true` to exclude markets past maturity.

**Pagination.** Response follows the list envelope: `{ cursor, data }`. Pass back `cursor` verbatim on the next call. A `null` `cursor` means the last page.

**Cache.** `public, max-age=5, stale-while-revalidate=2`.

active_only.description: When true, enforces maturity strictly after the current timestamp.

borrow_depth_gte.description: Filter for cached borrow-side order-book depth, in loan-token units, greater than or equal to this value.

borrow_depth_lte.description: Filter for cached borrow-side order-book depth, in loan-token units, less than or equal to this value.

chain_ids.description: Filter by chain ids. Supported chains: Ethereum (1), Base (8453), Arc (5042), and Robinhood Chain (4663). Required when any address filter is provided.

collateral_assets.description: Filter by collateral token addresses. Combine with chain_ids; lowercase input is checksummed.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page response.

enter_gates.description: Filter by enter gate addresses. Combine with chain_ids; lowercase input is checksummed.

lend_depth_gte.description: Filter for cached lend-side order-book depth, in loan-token units, greater than or equal to this value.

lend_depth_lte.description: Filter for cached lend-side order-book depth, in loan-token units, less than or equal to this value.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

liquidator_gates.description: Filter by liquidator gate addresses. Combine with chain_ids; lowercase input is checksummed.

listed.description: Filter by listing status. When true, returns only markets surfaced by the app trust layer; when false, only unlisted markets. Omit to return both.

loan_assets.description: Filter by loan token addresses. Combine with chain_ids; lowercase input is checksummed.

market_family_ids.description: Filter by Midnight market family ids. A family contains markets whose immutable parameters differ only by maturity.

market_ids.description: Filter by Midnight market ids. These ids are globally unique.

maturities.description: Filter by exact maturity timestamps, in unix seconds.

maturity_gte.description: Filter for maturities greater than or equal to this unix timestamp.

maturity_lte.description: Filter for maturities less than or equal to this unix timestamp.

oracle_addresses.description: Filter by collateral oracle addresses. Combine with chain_ids; lowercase input is checksummed.

total_units_gte.description: Filter for total units greater than or equal to this value.

total_units_lte.description: Filter for total units less than or equal to this value.

name: morpho_midnight_list_markets

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or null when there is none.

borrow_depth.description: Cached borrow-side order-book depth in loan-token units (sum of ask level assets). Null until first Router sync, or once the market has matured.

chain_id.description: Chain id where the market exists.

liquidation_cursor.description: Liquidation cursor for this collateral, WAD-scaled.

lltv.description: Liquidation loan-to-value for this collateral, WAD-scaled.

oracle.description: Oracle address used for this collateral.

current_settlement_fee_cbp.description: Current settlement fee in cbp. May include decimals because the current fee is interpolated.

current_settlement_fee_wad.description: Current settlement fee, WAD-scaled, based on time to maturity.

lend_depth.description: Cached lend-side order-book depth in loan-token units (sum of bid level assets). Null until first Router sync, or once the market has matured.

listed.description: Whether this market is surfaced by the app trust layer (curated listing).

market_family_id.description: Stable identifier shared by Midnight markets that differ only by maturity.

settlement_fee_schedule.description: Settlement fee schedule at [0d, 1d, 7d, 30d, 90d, 180d, 360d] time-to-maturity breakpoints.

fee_cbp.description: Settlement fee at this breakpoint, in cbp (1 cbp = 1e-6 WAD = 0.01 bps).

time_to_maturity_days.description: Settlement fee breakpoint time to maturity, in days.

tick_granularity.description: Offer tick granularity for this market. Valid offer ticks are multiples of this value.
